description: Remove redundancy from freshly written code: dead code, one-call wrappers, single-implementation interfaces, over-defensive error handling, comments that restate the code, speculative config, and features nobody asked for. Reads the git diff by default. Trigger on 精简代码 / 代码瘦身 / 删冗余 / 删掉没用的 / 这代码太啰嗦 / 简化一下 / 去掉过度设计 / 代码太臃肿 / simplify this / declutter / slim down / remove the bloat, and whenever AI just generated a batch of code the user finds bloated. Lists every finding for confirmation before touching anything; only deletes and inlines in place, never moves code between files. Also audits a cleanup after the fact via --audit — 上次那波精简有没有删错 / 检查一下这次清理 / 看看删过头了没. Do NOT use for: hunting bugs (use code-review-deep), design-pattern advice (use design-pattern-advisor), adding comments (use code-annotating), or refactoring that splits or relocates modules.
